offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures engineered filtration products, utility metering and grid communication systems, power system testing equipment, and aerospace and defense components. Sells to utilities, industrial and medical OEMs, aerospace and defense contractors, and government agencies, mainly through direct sales and engineered-product contracts.

primary_products.value: utility smart meters and grid communication devices; power system test equipment; filtration media and filter assemblies; aerospace valves and fluid control components; defense electronics

primary_services.value: power system testing and diagnostics; utility network software and data services; engineering and repair services

customer_segment.value: B2B: electric and gas utilities, aerospace primes, industrial and medical device OEMs; B2G: US defense agencies and government programs through defense contractors

end_markets.value: electric utilities; aerospace and defense; industrial filtration; medical devices; water and gas utilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: utility meters, test equipment, filters and aerospace components sold to OEMs and utilities; service fees: power testing, diagnostics, repair and software-based network services for utilities; project or contract: long-term defense and utility programs billed under government and customer contracts
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds metering, filtration and aerospace products from purchased materials and components, sold to utilities and OEMs; service provider: provides power system testing and repair services to electric utilities and industrial owners; software / platform: offers utility network communication and data software tied to its metering hardware
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: Sells across the United States with operations and customers in Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: Separate businesses: utility solutions, test equipment, filtration, and aerospace and defense products, each with different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to utilities, OEMs and defense customers; partners / resellers: system integrators and channel partners for utility and test equipment deployments; agents / brokers: independent sales representatives in international markets
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; partners / resellers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FCC certification for meters, FAA and aerospace quality standards, defense export controls, and environmental rules
